core_change_summary.description: Implemented delta diff sync for token storage: added GitTokenStorage and GithubTokenStorage modifications to compare local vs remote token sets and sync only changed parts, with granular comparison and raw data handling. The change also includes large generated package-lock.json and yarn.lock updates, and research/summary markdown files.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Lockfiles and documentation files dominate the line count; the actual delta diff implementation is in the storage source files.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added delta diff logic in GithubTokenStorage and research markdown.
Iterated through multiple commits refactoring delta diff approach, moving logic between GitTokenStorage and GithubTokenStorage.
Added detailed logging and fixed comparison issues.
Refactored into GitTokenStorage base class then simplified, eventually using raw data comparison in RemoteTokenStorage.
Final commit added granular delta diff optimization; no review; PR closed without merge.
